subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw define a new core session-level process/step event contract now, and what schema, replay, and security model should be the canonical source of progress?
rationale: This choice changes the public gateway/session event contract and can expose intermediate run state, so automation should not pick the taxonomy, persistence, or authorization boundary alone.

options.title: Design the core event contract
options.body: Approve a scoped process/step event design with redaction, permissions, replay, ordering, and migration from existing progress streams before implementation.

options.title: Extend existing item/session streams
options.body: Keep the current event families and narrow the work to filling gaps in item, plan, session.tool, and task-ledger payloads without a new process.* taxonomy.

options.title: Defer to narrower consumers
options.body: Leave this broad contract open or deferred while solving narrower progress surfaces such as sessions_send, Control UI Codex progress, or CLI JSON streaming independently.

recommendation.title: Design the core event contract
recommendation.body: Approve a scoped process/step event design with redaction, permissions, replay, ordering, and migration from existing progress streams before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest existing structured activity surface was introduced by steipete, and the decision is primarily about the permanent core progress contract.
